_comment: Terms machine translation mangles or renders inconsistently. Both lists are masked before translation and substituted back afterwards, so they work identically on every backend.
_protect: Keeps the English term verbatim. Fine for French/Spanish; wrong for Hebrew, where a Latin-script word mid-sentence looks out of place - use 'replace' with a Hebrew form instead.
_replace: Forces an exact per-language rendering, and takes precedence over 'protect'. IMPORTANT: prefer proper nouns. The model cannot grammatically agree with a token it cannot see, so forcing a common-noun phrase can produce broken agreement - forcing 'the sages' to 'los Sabios' yielded 'el los Sabios dice'. Proper nouns (Rashi, Midrash, Rambam) carry no agreement and are always safe.
